findings.fact: VAE Attention selects ck.rms_rope_split_half under grad-enabled mode and ck.rms_rope_split_half_ otherwise. native_training_math replaces only the functional public function with eager.rms_rope_split_half; both passes set mm.in_training=True.
findings.implication: The original smoke does not compare only autograd on/off: it also changes the RMS+RoPE implementation family.

findings.fact: Ascend functional RoPE uses torch_npu.npu_rms_norm and torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul. Its inplace form calls the same functional implementation then copies outputs to q/k. Eager uses F.rms_norm followed by multiplication/addcmul rotation.
findings.implication: Different kernel accumulation/rounding is a plausible explanation for the FP16 decoded mismatch, not yet a quantitatively isolated root cause. Registry default priority puts ascend before cuda/triton/eager, but constraints/fallback and selected backend must be logged at runtime.

findings.fact: Ascend rms_rope_split_half is an ordinary undecorated Python function, signature (q,k,freqs_cis,q_scale,k_scale=None,epsilon=1e-6,rot_dim=0). It accepts both keywords passed by VAE. It directly calls torch_npu primitives, not the public torch.library custom-op wrapper.
findings.implication: A scoped functional replacement is interface-compatible and retains the inference backend primitives; actual primitive backward support remains untested. Direct invocation must validate Ascend constraints instead of silently falling back.

findings.fact: Inplace path returns q/k views sliced from shared qkv; functional path returns newly allocated tensors. Transposing them can yield different attention input strides/contiguity even with identical element values.
findings.implication: If the Ascend functional variant still fails parity, log q/k/v shapes,dtypes,strides and locate first mismatch before changing attention. Do not attribute every residual mismatch solely to RMS/RoPE arithmetic.

findings.fact: Comfy optimized_attention is selected at module import from configured backend. The inspected attention_pytorch path calls comfy.ops.scaled_dot_product_attention, then Torch SDPA. No explicit grad-enabled branch exists in that wrapper. The same mm.in_training=True is used for both existing smoke forwards.
findings.implication: Attention is a secondary possible source through Torch/NPU kernel or layout selection; this static audit has not identified its actual kernel or proved it identical in both passes.
